verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability is importing many environment variables at once from a .env file or stdin with hot-reload (maritime-docs-11). Multi-item work otherwise has to be scripted: the CLI emits machine-readable JSON (maritime-docs-9, maritime-docs-22), `provision` is idempotent (maritime-docs-45), and an AI agent can recreate each migrated workload one by one (maritime-docs-16). Missing for 10: native bulk or batch operations across many agents (bulk deploy, update, delete, sleep/wake), a documented batch API endpoint, bulk actions in the UI, and any hands-on corroboration.
